title: Alexandr Wang on building Meta Superintelligence Labs: research-led flywheel, durable foundations, personal agents
summary: Wang explains how he designed Meta Superintelligence Labs from a blank slate: research-led, high talent density, no artificial deadlines. He describes a flywheel of models, products and infrastructure, and reflects on trading youthful impatience for long-term foundations.

principles.text: Run models, products and infrastructure as one flywheel: frontier models enable products, products fund infrastructure, infrastructure enables better models.
principles.quote: by building frontier models... that enables to build incredible products. Those products, as they gain scale, then give us the ability to grow our infrastructure footprint... And then that will enable us to build even greater models

principles.text: Best AI products come from researchers thinking about product and product people thinking about research, working together, not handoffs.
principles.quote: we're I think past the phase where it's just about research in, you know, a corner and then that hands off to product people and then they deploy that.

principles.text: Design the organization from a blank slate around scientific foundations and talent density, and remove artificial deadlines.
principles.quote: We're going to set up with the incredible talent density and the focus on the long-term science. We're going to remove artificial deadlines so that we're actually building the technology at the best pace.

principles.text: Don't cut corners for short-term outcomes that mortgage the long-term opportunity.
principles.quote: we're not just setting ourselves up to cut a corner here or to opt in for some short-term outcome, but but mortgage the long-term opportunity.

principles.text: Businesses with staying power build a foundation that is hard to replicate; don't let impatience drive you too far.
principles.quote: the ones with true staying power have built some sort of foundation that is actually very difficult to replicate. And it's something that is it's almost like a seed that is planted and grows

principles.text: Distribution is a core AI advantage: reach to billions of users lets you deploy personal agents in ways other labs cannot.
principles.quote: It has the distribution, it has the billions and billions of users, it has the scale, it has the business model, it has um the incredible talent, it has the infrastructure.
